correctness.rationale: For the 16-vertex (Z/4)^2 Shrikhande graph, independent exhaustive exact calculation found 384 disconnected triples, 65,162 nonempty faces of their complement-generated ordinary three-cut complex. A 32,573-pair Morse matching is acyclic on all 519,328 Hasse covers, with critical cells dimensions 0:1, 11:13, 12:2. Independent signed integral boundary has a 2×2 unimodular minor, so the two attaching maps are primitive; connectivity and high-dimensional Hurewicz cancel the 2 pairs, leaving ∨11 S11. The pure 12-dimensional complex is nonshellable. Ordinary, not total, cut.
